cases.case_label: SVA in TAF1 (XDP): Taf1-deficient fly model and patient fibroblasts
cases.mechanism_detail: Paper states the XDP SVA moderately reduces TAF1 expression; metabolic changes seen in Taf1-deficient flies were not confirmed in XDP patient fibroblasts with minor TAF1 reduction.
cases.quote: The SVA insertion moderately disrupts gene expression; however, the underlying disease mechanism remains enigmatic.
